target: 750 Fons Vitae

source: 750 Source of Life
target: 750 Fons Vitae

source: After a few seconds, Lugano stuttered, “Can you actually eat that?”
target: Post paucos secundos, Lugano balbutivit: “Num hoc vere edere potes?”

source: What happens if you do eat it? What are the changes?
target: Quid evenit, si id edis? Quae mutationes fiunt?

source: Does it cause the Child of God to be born?
target: Num hoc facit ut Filium Dei nascatur?

source: Lumian glanced at Lugano’s arm and said, “What can’t be eaten?”
target: Lumian brachium Luganonis aspexit et dixit: “Quid ederi non potest?”

source: Lugano suddenly felt a sharp phantom pain and shook his head vigorously.
target: Lugano subito acutum dolorem phantasmaticum sensit et caput vehementer concussit.

source: “No, never mind!”
target: “Non, nihil refert!”

source: He wanted to get away from Ludwig and Lumian but couldn’t think of an excuse on the spot.
target: Volebat Ludwig et Lumian recedere, sed causam statim excogitare non potuit.

source: After Ludwig swallowed a mouthful of cheese bread, he spoke slowly, “Top-tier ingredients don’t need much accompaniment or seasoning.
target: Postquam Ludwig morsum panis casei deglutivit, lente dixit: “Ingredientia optima non indigent magno comitatu aut condimento.

source: We just need to give it a symbol.
target: Nobis solum illi signum dare necesse est.

source: That includes nine main staple ingredients: wheat, oats, rye, rice, potatoes, sweet potatoes, corn, cassava, and any other kind of bean.
target: Hoc comprehendit novem materias praecipuas: triticum, avena, secale, oryza, poma terrae, batatas dulces, maizem, cassavam, atque omne aliud genus fabarum.

source: Cook them with the umbilical remains in cow’s or sheep’s milk for half an hour, and it’s ready to eat.
target: Coque eas cum reliquiis umbilicalibus in lacte vaccino aut ovino per dimidium horae, et parata est ad edendum.

source: This dish is called ‘Source of Life.”
target: Hoc ferculum vocatur “Fons Vitae.”

source: “Are you cooking or performing a mystical rite?” Lumian muttered under his breath.
target: “Num coquis aut ritu mystico fungaris?” Lumian submurmuravit.

source: Of course, a Gourmet pathway’s Chef, who concocted alcoholic beverages and cooked various dishes, was essentially conducting corresponding mystical rites.
target: Certe, coquus viae Gourmet, qui potiones alcoholicas conficiebat et varia fercula coquebat, re vera ritus mysticos pertinentes agebat.

source: Thoughtfully, Lumian asked, “Actually, it doesn’t have to be these nine ingredients, right?
target: Cogitans, Lumian quaesivit: “Revera, non oportet ut haec novem sint, nonne?

source: As long as the concept of main ingredients and their quantity is satisfied? Likewise, other kinds of milk would work too?”
target: Dummodo notio ingredientium principalium et eorum quantitas satisfaciatur? Similiter, alias lactis species quoque valent?

source: Ludwig shook his head.
target: Ludwig caput nutavit.

source: “No, this way tastes the best.”
target: “Non, hoc modo optimum sapit.”

source: So, what you’re saying is, the method I mentioned would work but won’t taste as good?
target: Ita, quid dicis igitur? Methodus quam dixi operabitur, sed non tam sapida erit?

source: No wonder it’s the Gourmet pathway, always chasing culinary perfection…
target: Non mirum est quod haec sit via Gourmet, semper perfectionem culinariam persequens…

source: Lumian stood up and instructed Lugano to buy some of the ingredients.
target: Lumian surrexit et Luganone iubet ut aliqua ingredientia emerent.

source: Lumian’s Traveler’s Bag only contained dry rations that could be eaten right out of the package.
target: Saccus viatorius Lumiani tantum rationes siccas habebat, quae ex sarcina edi poterant.

source: For Trier, a leading global metropolis, the ingredients Ludwig needed were easily collected, and by noon, Lumian and Lugano had returned to see Ludwig placing the main ingredients along with the umbilical remnant into a stew pot filled with several hundred milliliters of milk.
target: Pro Trier, urbe insigne orbis terrarum, ingredientia quae Ludwig desiderabat facile collecta erant, et meridie redierunt Lumian et Lugano ut viderent Ludovicum materias principales atque reliquiem umbilicalem in ollam decoctionis, repletam pluribus centum mililitris lactis, inferre.

source: These steps had to be completed by a Chef himself, to endow them with mysticism, to coax out the designated uniqueness of the ingredients and maintain them to a degree conducive to absorption.
target: Hi gradus a coquo ipso perficiendi erant, ut eis mysticum infunderetur, ut unicitatem designatam ingredientium evelleret atque servaret ad modum assimilationis aptum.

source: Done by anyone else, the dish might have no effect or turn into poison.
target: Si ab alio quis factum esset, ferculum aut sine effectu esset aut in venenum converteretur.

source: After simmering for a while, Lumian smelled the starchy aroma mixed with the milk and saw dense milky white steam rising above the pot.
target: Post aliquod tempore coctum, Lumian odor amidonaceus mixta cum lacte sensit et vidit vaporem densum, album lacteum, super ollam emergentem.

source: The steam did not disperse but condensed in midair and slowly settled back into the pot, carrying a tantalizing scent tinged with blood.
target: Vapor non dispersus est, sed in aere condensatus lenteque in ollam rediit, ferens odorem leporem sanguine tinctum.

source: At that moment, Ludwig turned to Lumian and licked his lips, asking, “Do you want to add sugar or salt?”
target: Illo momento, Ludwig ad Lumian conversus, labia lambens, rogavit: “Visne addere saccharum an sal?”

source: “What differences do they bring?” Lumian asked cautiously.
target: “Quae differentiae afferunt?” quaesivit cautim Lumian.

source: Ludwig responded seriously, “The taste, one is sweet, the other is salty.
target: Ludwig respondit serio: “Gustus: unus dulcis, alter salsus.

source: Which do you prefer?”
target: Quod mavis?

source: Lumian, sensing the choice, relaxed and asked with a smile, “Which do you prefer?”
target: Lumian, electionem sentiens, laxatus et sub risu rogavit: “Quod mavis?”

source: “I can’t eat it…” Ludwig said regretfully, mumbling, “Sweet is tasty, salty is good too.
target: “Id edere non possum…” Ludwig paeniter submurmurans dixit: “Dulce sapit, salsum quoque optime.”

source: If only it could be split into two parts, one sweet, one salty…”
target: Utinam in duas partes dividi posset, unam dulcem, alteram salsam…

source: As he spoke, the young boy, seemingly agitated, sprinkled some salt and then tossed in some sugar.
target: Dum loquebatur, puer iunior, viso excitatus, paululum salis sparsit et deinde saccharum adiecit.

source: Lumian watched amusedly, not stopping him.
target: Lumian ridens observavit eum, neque eum prohibens.

source: For him, the taste of the Source of Life was not important; its effect was.
target: Ei autem non gustus Fons Vitae gravis erat, sed effectus eius.

source: Finally, Ludwig instructed Lugano to extinguish the flame and removed the contents of the pot.
target: Denique Ludwig Luganone imperavit ut flammam exstingueret et contentum ollae removeret.

source: It was a palm‑sized piece of starchy congealment, white and soft, sticky and gooey.
target: Erat pars coacta amidonacea, mensura palmae, alba et mollis, viscosa et glutinosa.

source: The surface of the food was covered with red spots, as if blood had seeped out from within.
target: Superficies ferculi maculis rubris tectus erat, quasi sanguis ex intus effusus esset.

source: “It’s ready to eat.” Ludwig tried hard not to drool.
target: “Paratum est ad edendum.” Ludwig strenue conatus est ne saliva effunderetur.

source: “Will it be effective with just one bite, or do I need to eat it all?” Lumian asked, his curiosity reminiscent of his days learning various experiments, which often frustrated Aurore with his questions.
target: “Unico morsu efficax erit, an totum edendum sit?” quaesivit Lumian, cuius curiositas diem experimentorum discendorum meminisse faciebat, quae saepe Aurorem per quaestiones vexabant.

source: “All of it,” Ludwig said with a look of disappointment.
target: “Totum,” inquit Ludwig vultu languido.

source: Lumian picked up the steaming, slightly scalding food, brought it to his mouth, and took a bite.
target: Lumian victum vaporosum, paulo scaldidum, levavit, ad os tulit, et morsum cepit.

source: The sweet and salty flavors melded together, offsetting each other’s intensity in a unique way that relieved Lumian of any mental burden.
target: Sapores dulces et salsi se miscuerunt, alterorum intensitatem in modo unico mitigantes, quo Lumian onus animi levatus est.

source: He quickly devoured the Source of Life.
target: Celeriter Fons Vitae devoravit.

source: “Will it work right away?” an eager Lumian asked, already resolute in his intentions.
target: “Statim fungiet?” quaesivit Lumian alacer, iam consiliis certus.

source: Ludwig pointed to the master bedroom.
target: Ludwig ad cellam principalem designavit.

source: “You’ll need to sleep first.”
target: “Primum dormire debebis.”

source: Sleep? With a slight sigh, Lumian left the dining table, returned to his room, and lay down on his bed.
target: “Dormire?” Paululum suspirans, Lumian mensam edendi reliquit, ad cubiculum rediit, et in lecto se iacuit.

source: Closing his eyes, he felt his body gradually warm up, his consciousness becoming heavier and heavier…
target: Oculos clausos habens, sensit corpus suum paulatim calefieri, atque conscientia magis magisque grave fieri…

source: In the darkness, Lumian heard soft sobs.
target: In tenebris, Lumian levia fletus audivit.

source: He turned his head, carefully discerning the sound.
target: Caput vertit, sonum caute discernens.

source: It was of a little girl whispering, “Mommy… Mommy…”
target: Fuit puellae parvulae, susurrans: “Māter… Māter…”

source: The voice grew louder, more mature, and more piercing.
target: Vox augebatur, magis madura, et acutius reddita.

source: “Mommy! Mommy!”
target: “Māter! Māter!”

source: The cries drew closer, as if they were right beside Lumian, resonating within him.
target: Clamores propius accedebant, quasi iuxta Lumian essent, resonantes intra eum.

source: “Mommy! Mommy!”
target: “Māter! Māter!”

source: Inside my body… Lumian suddenly jolted awake, regaining his senses.
target: Intra corpus meum… Lumian subito excitatus evigilavit, sensus suos recipiens.

source: The darkness shattered, and sunlight pierced his eyes.
target: Tenebrae dissipatae sunt, et lumen solis oculos eius percussit.

source: He sat up abruptly, freeing himself from the dream.
target: Repente surrexit, somnio se liberans.

source: The cries of “mommy, mommy” still echoed faintly in his mind.
target: Clamores “māter, māter” adhuc vage in mente eius resonabant.

source: Did I hear the Child of God crying? Lumian looked down at himself.
target: Audivine Filium Dei fletum? Lumian se introspexit.

source: He undressed and found nothing unusual, but he knew something about him was different now, an indescribable change.
target: Se exuit et nihil insolitum invenit, sed intellexit aliquid in se nunc differre – mutationem ineffabilem.

source: He didn’t feel the Great Mother’s gaze, which made him even more cautious.
target: Non sensit conspectum Magnae Matris, quod eum magis cautum reddidit.

source: Dressed again, he left his room to find Lugano sneaking glances his way.
target: Iterum vestitus, ex cubiculo processit ut Luganum, clam aspiciens, inveniret.

source: “Are—are you alright?” Lugano, who had been caught red-handed, asked instinctively.
target: “Esne bene?” quaesivit Lugano, qui in flagrante deprehensus erat.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian risit.

source: “It’s okay, I won’t become the Child of God of the Great Mother.”
target: “Omnia bene, non fiam Filium Dei Magnae Matris.”

source: Seeing Lugano eyeing his stomach, Lumian added, “Nor have I conceived Her.”
target: Videntes Lugano ventrem suum intuentem, Lumian addidit: “Nec Eam concepi.”

source: After speaking, he left the still‑concerned Lugano behind and walked out of the apartment.
target: Postquam locutus est, reliquit Lugano adhuc sollicium et ex conclavi processit.

source: The afternoon sun was perfect, and with nothing much to do in the next couple of days, Lumian decided to stake out a particular spot.
target: Sol meridianus perfecte fulgebat, et cum paucis in proximis diebus agendi essent, Lumian constituit statuere certum locum.

source: That place was the Trier catacombs.
target: Ille locus erat catacumbae Treverenses.

source: Knowing that Harrison from Resurrection Island might appear at places associated with death, darkness, dusk, and decay, Lumian’s first thoughts were of the Dream Festival and the Trier catacombs—locations rife with death and dark mysticism.
target: Sciens Harrison de Insula Resurrectionis posse apparere in locis morti, tenebris, crepusculo, et corruptione pertinentibus, primum Lumiani mente venit de Festo Somniorum et catacumbis Treverensibus – loca abundantia in morte et mysteriis obscuris.

source: In the first level of the catacombs, by the “Entrance to the Old Ossuary” leading deeper below, Lumian sat next to a withered, scattered skeleton with a lit white candle, quietly observing each visitor descending into or returning from the depths.
target: In primo gradibus catacumbarum, prope “Ingressum ad Vetus Ossuarium” quod profundiora ducit, Lumian sedebat iuxta scheletrum marcescens et dispersum, cum candela alba accensa, quiete observans singulos visitatores, qui in profundum descendebant aut redibant.

source: Soon, a group of students passed by, spotting Lumian sitting alongside the catacombs bones.
target: Mox coetus studentium transivit, et Lumian sedens iuxta ossa catacumbarum animadvertus est.

source: The leader, a tall, thin man with glasses, asked Lumian curiously, “Why are you sitting here?”
target: Dux, vir altus et tenuus cum oculis speculatoribus, quaesivit a Lumiano: “Cur hic sedes?”

source: Lumian casually responded, “I’ve been down to the lower levels many times and lost interest.
target: Lumian leviter respondit: “Iam pluries in gradus inferiores descendi et studium amisi.

source: Now, I just want to sit here quietly and watch everyone and everybody that comes and goes, to see who never leaves.”
target: Iam sola huc quies sedere volo et omnes, qui veniunt ac abeunt, observare, ut videam quem numquam relinquant.

source: “That sounds interesting,” the students said, holding their white candles.
target: “Hoc interest,” dixerunt studenti, candela alba tenentes.

source: They decided to sit down too and observe if any of those returning from the depths showed signs of fear.
target: Constituerunt quoque sedere et observare an quis e iis, qui e profundis redibant, signa timoris ostenderet.

source: The tall, bespectacled man chose to sit beside Lumian and struck up a conversation.
target: Vir altus, oculis speculatoribus, secum Luminum congregatus, sermonem inchoavit.

source: “Do you really think not lighting a white candle here could lead to mishaps?”
target: “Vere putasne, si hanc candelae albam lucem non accenderis, infausta evenire possint?”

source: Lumian glanced at him and chuckled, “You could try it, and we’d all see what happens.”
target: Lumian eum aspexit et subridens dixit: “Potes id experiri, et omnes quid eveniat videbimus.”

source: Before the students could respond, Lumian spoke in a relaxed tone, “I didn’t believe in these things before, but then…”
target: Priusquam studenti responderent, Lumian leniter locutus est: “Priore his rebus non credebam, sed tum…”

source: He suddenly lowered his voice.
target: Subito vocem demisit.

source: Two of the female students blurted out, “What happened?”
target: Duae discipulae feminae repente exclamaverunt: “Quid accidit?”

source: “Then…” Lumian wore a reminiscent expression, “I met someone who had encountered the Montsouris ghost. You know the legend of the Montsouris ghost, right?”
target: “Tum…” inquit Lumian, vultu rememorante, “Convenī aliquem qui spiritum Montsouris passa esset. Fabulam de spiritu Montsouris nostis, nonne?”

source: The students nodded together.
target: Discipuli simul nutuerunt.

source: You really know Trier’s spooky tales well… Typical of Underground Trier creatures—students…
target: Revera bene nosti fabulas terribiles Trieris… Typicae sunt creaturae subterraneae Trier – scilicet studenti…

source: Lumian sighed, “His immediate family all died, and he thought he could escape it.
target: Lumian suspiravit: “Universa familia eius proxima perivit, et putavit se id evitare posse.

source: But one day, when I went to see him, I found him hanged from a window frame.
target: Sed quadam die, cum ad eum accessi, eum reperi suspenditum a structura fenestrarum.

source: “Since then, I’ve been strictly following every rule of Underground Trier.”
target: “Ex illo tempore, omnes regulas subterraneae Trier stricte sequor.”

source: The students looked at each other, a bit frightened by the tale told by a peer.
target: Studentes inter se spectaverunt, paulo territi fabulae a pari narratae.

source: “It seems we really shouldn’t extinguish this candle,” the tall student with glasses said regretfully.
target: “Videtur, quidem, hanc candelam non oportere exstinguere,” inquit tristiter altus student cum oculis speculatoribus.

source: Lumian lowered his voice again, “Have you ever encountered such a thing?
target: Lumian iterum vocem demisit: “Numquamne talem rem experitus es?

source: There are extra books, blankets, and clothes in your dorm—none which belong to you—but the administrator tells you that no one else lives there.”
target: Extra libros, stragula, et vestimenta in dormitorio tuo sunt—nulla tibi pertinent—sed administrator tibi affirmat neminem aliud ibi habitare.

source: Two students turned pale, as if hearing the most terrifying ghost story.
target: Duo discipuli pallidi facti sunt, quasi audientes fabulam phantasmatis terribilissimam.

source: As if they were seeking a lifeline, they asked, “Yes, that happens, do you know why?”
target: Veluti auxilium quaerentes, rogaverunt: “Ita fit, scisne cur?”

source: Lumian shook his head and sighed, “I heard those are the people who extinguished their candles here.
target: Lumian caput negavit et suspiravit: “Audivi eos esse qui candelae suas hic exstingerunt.

source: They completely vanished, with no one remembering them.”
target: Penitus evanuerunt, nec quisquam eos meminisse potuit.

source: Hearing this, the tall student shivered instinctively.
target: Hoc auditu, altus student instinctim tremuit.

source: Suddenly, he felt something tap his shoulder.
target: Subito sensit aliquid in umero eius contingere.

source: He turned to look and saw a ghastly pale skeletal hand.
target: Conversus est ut aspiceret et vidit manum scheletricam pallidam et terribilem.

source: “Ah!” He screamed, jumping up.
target: “Heu!” exclamavit, saltans.

source: Lumian pulled back the bone hand he had picked up somewhere, his smile mocking.
target: Lumian retractavit manum ossatam quam alibi acceperat, risu irridente.

source: “You’re really scaredy‐cats! Scared already?”
target: “Vere, estis pusillanimi! Iam timetis?”

source: The students were stunned, and after a while, they forcefully said, “No! That was just a reflex!”
target: Discipuli stupuerunt, et post breve intervallum voce firmiter dixerunt: “Non! Id solum reflexus erat!”

source: As they seriously considered whether to beat up the prankster, someone came up the stone steps to the second level.
target: Dum serio cogitabant utrum lusorem percutere deberent, aliquis scala lapidea ad gradum secundum ascendit.

source: He wore a blue top and yellow pants, his face deeply wrinkled and his white hair sparse and dry, holding a short lit white candle.
target: Indutus erat tunica caerulea et bracas flavas, facie profunde rugosa, capillis albis raris et siccis, tenens parvam candelae albam accensam.

source: It was an elderly catacombs administrator.
target: Erat senex curator catacumbarum.

source: Lumian slightly frowned.
target: Lumian leviter frontem contraxit.

source: He had seen this catacombs administrator before in the giant tomb chamber housing the Samaritan Women’s Spring, but the administrator hadn’t used a white candle then.
target: Hunc curator catacumbarum antea viderat in magna camera sepulcrali, quae Fons Samaritarum Feminarum continebat, sed tunc candela alba non adhibebatur.
